neighbours.label: An opening parenthesis introducing the numeric conversion of a physical measurement.
fire: The train reached 200 mph (322 km/h) during the trial.
The tunnel is 5 miles (8 kilometers) long.
The aircraft climbed to 30000 feet (9144 meters) before turning.
The cable extends 100 meters (328 feet) across the valley.
The vessel carries 500 tons (454 tonnes) of cargo.
The runner covered 10 kilometers (6.2 miles) before noon.
The tank holds 50 gallons (189 liters) of water.
The bird flew at 60 mph (97 km/h) over the field.
quiet: The train reached 200 mph, or 322 km/h, during the trial.
The tunnel is 5 miles, or 8 kilometers, long.
The aircraft climbed to 30000 feet, or 9144 meters, before turning.

predictions: Fire sentences should outrank the matched near misses; assessed once by quick-8+8@2. Failure is retained without revision.
notes: Random 16-pole sweep. Labels derived from both-pole cards and top-32 peak-token counts. No band archive covers this neuron. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory probes, when declared, used different sentences from this pre-registration. The card's commonest peak is an opening parenthesis; exploratory conversions varied in strength. Controls preserve both numbers and units without parentheses.
